info.name: Battlefront Customer API v1
info.description: EXT-62 React Native handoff. Implemented API only. Read MOBILE_API_HANDOFF.md before running. Use disposable local data: cart/order requests mutate data and deduct inventory. Select individual requests; this is not an unattended end-to-end runner. Examples are synthetic. Set base_url to your reachable API root ending /api/v1. Public and guest requests explicitly use No Auth. No credentials are included.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Set local test credentials. Register OR log in; sign out last. No CSRF cookie is required.

request.description: 201: customer + 30-day token. Unique email required. 422 invalid fields; 429 after five attempts/IP/minute. Registration does not persist default_delivery_address.

exec: if (typeof value === "string") return value.replace(/\{\{([^{}]+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => String(pm.environment.get(key) ?? ""));
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, entry]) => [key, resolve(entry)]));

request.description: 200: new 30-day token. Invalid credentials and administrator login both return 401. Five attempts/email+IP/minute.

request.description: Revokes only the supplied token. Saves it locally as revoked_token for the negative check, then clears token and conversation context.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 204) { pm.environment.set("revoked_token", pm.environment.get("token") || ""); pm.environment.set("token", ""); pm.environment.set("context_token", ""); pm.environment.set("guest_context_token", ""); }

item.name: Profile
item.description: Customer bearer token required. Only the authenticated customer's profile is addressed.

request.description: Name and email required even for PATCH; each max 255. Address nullable/max 255; blank becomes null. Omit address to preserve it. Duplicate email: 422. No password or role update.

if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, entry]) => [key, resolve(entry)]));

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Public. Active products/categories; zero or missing stock remains visible. Stock is Sagay only.

request.description: Enable optional Params after populating variables. q, brand and single tag combine with category_id OR up to 50 distinct active category_ids entries. Disable singular category_id when using category_ids. Bounds are inclusive effective prices (discount_price ?? price), 0..9999999999.99, at most 2 decimals; max_price >= min_price. sort is featured (default), price_asc or price_desc; price ties use name then ID. Fixed 12/page; follow links.next with filters retained. Conflicting category inputs, invalid IDs, reversed bounds or invalid sort return native 422 errors. New options apply only to the API; the web catalog ignores them. No per_page or stock filter.

exec: const params = pm.request.url.query.all().filter(p => !p.disabled).map(p => ({ key: p.key, value: pm.variables.replaceIn(p.value || "") }));
if (options.min_price && options.min_price.trim()) pm.test("Inclusive minimum effective price", () => prices.forEach(price => pm.expect(price).to.be.at.least(Number(options.min_price))));
if (options.max_price && options.max_price.trim()) pm.test("Inclusive maximum effective price", () => prices.forEach(price => pm.expect(price).to.be.at.most(Number(options.max_price))));

if (["price_asc", "price_desc"].includes(options.sort)) pm.test("Effective price order", () => prices.slice(1).forEach((price, i) => options.sort === "price_asc" ? pm.expect(price).to.be.at.least(prices[i]) : pm.expect(price).to.be.at.most(prices[i])));

item.name: Cart
item.description: Customer only. Add accumulates; update replaces quantity; all successful mutations return refreshed cart with 200.

request.description: Positive integer quantity; cumulative quantity must fit live stock. 422 errors.product_id or errors.quantity. Does not reserve inventory.

exec: if (typeof value === "string") return value.replace(/\{\{([^{}]+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => String(pm.environment.get(key) ?? ""));
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, entry]) => [key, resolve(entry)]));

const item = body.data.items.find(item => String(item.product.id) === String(pm.environment.get("product_id")));
  if (item) pm.environment.set("cart_item_id", String(item.id));

originalRequest.description: Positive integer quantity; cumulative quantity must fit live stock. 422 errors.product_id or errors.quantity. Does not reserve inventory.

item.name: Checkout and Orders
item.description: Use disposable local data. Explicitly submit selected cart-item IDs for preview and placement. Only purchased rows are removed and their inventory deducted; unselected rows remain. Refill purchased products before another placement.

request.description: Preview explicitly selected owned cart-item IDs. Repeat cart_item_ids[] query parameters for multiple/all items. Returns selected-only subtotal, pickup_quote and 12 delivery_quotes; unselected fragile/bulky items never affect handling or ETA. Missing/empty/malformed/duplicate selection: 422 selection validation errors. Foreign/missing/stale/unavailable items: 422 errors.cart. Select a canonical destination from server quotes and refresh before payment.

item.name: Place pickup order — cash or card

request.description: Use cash or card_at_store. Omit delivery_destination, delivery_address and payment_proof. Server snapshots current subtotal with zero delivery fee and no Shipment. 422 on empty/conflicting cart. Submit only selected cart-item IDs; add IDs to the array for multiple/all-item checkout. Purchased items alone are removed; unselected items remain. No omitted-selection fallback.

item.description: Initial proof goes in POST /orders. This endpoint replaces rejected evidence; prepare eligible rejected payment via existing web administration.
